description: For one product not yet released: the expected release window, how it is known (announced by the company, a reported window, an iDevice estimate, or the company's release cadence) with how sure iDevice is (Confirmed, Reported or Our read) and who stated it, and the published probability where iDevice publishes one: how often reported windows of that width have held for products later announced, for the window's calendar year and for the window as stated, with the sample size. A window with no recorded basis, or a reported window with no recorded source, is refused (answered: false, refused says why); so is a product already released.
name: release_odds
title: Release window and its odds
